keywords.def: a raw product that can be bought and sold
agree to do something and get involved with doing it

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 这是BBC学英语的6分钟英语节目。

sentences.en: I’m Neil. And I’m Beth. Neil, what type of foods do you often eat?
sentences.zh: 我是Neil。我是Beth。Neil，你平时经常吃什么种类的食物呢？

sentences.en: Well, basic things that fill me up – that's sort of bread, potatoes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就是能让我吃饱的基本食物——比如面包、土豆之类的。

sentences.en: Well, food like this, which is regularly eaten by many people, is known as a staple.
sentences.zh: 嗯，像这种经常被很多人食用的食物，被称为主食。

sentences.en: In Britain, bread is a popular staple, but for large parts of the world there’s another food which is number one: rice.
sentences.zh: 在英国，面包是一种很受欢迎的主食，但在世界上很大一部分地区，还有另一种食物稳居第一：大米。

sentences.en: That’s right. Over half the world’s population eats rice as the staple food, especially in Asia.
sentences.zh: 没错。全球有一半以上的人口以大米为主食，特别是在亚洲。

sentences.en: But rice is a very ‘thirsty’ crop which needs lots of water to grow, and this is becoming a problem because of droughts and flooding caused by climate change.
sentences.zh: 但水稻是一种非常“耗水”的作物，生长需要大量的水，而由于气候变化导致的干旱和洪水，这正成为一个问题。

sentences.en: In this programme, we’ll be hearing about a pioneering new technique helping farmers to grow rice in the face of a changing climate.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将听到一项开创性的新技术，它正在帮助农民在不断变化的气候面前种植水稻。

sentences.en: As usual, we’ll be learning some useful new words and phrases, and remember you can find all the vocabulary from this programme on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，我们将学习一些实用的新单词和短语，请记住，你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到本节目的所有词汇。

sentences.en: But first I have a question for you, Beth.
sentences.zh: 但首先我有一个问题要问你，Beth。

sentences.en: Just now I mentioned that rice is a very ‘thirsty’ crop – so how much water is needed to grow one kilogram of rice?
sentences.zh: 刚才我提到水稻是一种非常“耗水”的作物——那么种植一公斤大米需要多少水呢？

sentences.en: Is it: a) 1,000 to 3,000 litres? b) 3,000 to 5,000 litres? or, c) 5,000 to 7,000 litres?
I'm going to say c) 5,000 to 7,000 litres.
Well, we’ll find out the correct answer at the end of the programme.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们将在节目结束时揭晓正确答案。

sentences.en: Dr Yvonne Pinto is Director General of the International Rice Research Institute, or IRRI for short, based in the Philippines.
sentences.zh: Yvonne Pinto 博士是总部位于菲律宾的国际水稻研究所（简称 IRRI）的所长。

sentences.en: Here she explains more about the global popularity of rice to BBC World Service programme, The Food Chain: Between 50 and 56 percent of the world's population rely on rice as the principal staple.
sentences.zh: 在这里，她向BBC世界服务部的节目《The Food Chain》详细介绍了水稻的全球普及程度：全球有 50% 到 56% 的人口依赖水稻作为主要主食。

sentences.en: Now, that's roughly about four billion people, and it is one of those commodities that is grown really extensively, particularly in South Asia and Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 大约有四十亿人，它是那种被广泛种植的商品，特别是在南亚和东南亚。

sentences.en: But increasingly the appetite for it is growing in continents like Africa, and of course there are also Latin American and European rice varieties.
sentences.zh: 但人们对它的胃口在非洲等大洲正日益增长，当然，拉丁美洲和欧洲也有大米品种。

sentences.en: Rice is a commodity, a produce that can be bought and sold.
sentences.zh: 大米是一种商品，一种可以买卖的农产品。

sentences.en: Like other crops, rice has varieties – different types, for example brown rice, long-grained rice or basmati.
sentences.zh: 与其他作物一样，水稻也有各种品种——不同的类型，例如糙米、长粒米或巴斯马蒂香米。

sentences.en: Much of the research into rice today is focused on making new varieties that can adapt to the changing environment and grow in conditions of either too much or too little water.
sentences.zh: 如今对水稻的大部分研究都集中在培育新品种上，这些新品种能够适应不断变化的环境，并在水分过多或过少的条件下生长。

sentences.en: Over half the world’s population eats rice and there’s a growing demand in Africa and Europe too, so clearly there’s an appetite, a strong desire, for rice worldwide.
sentences.zh: 全球有一半以上的人口吃大米，非洲和欧洲对大米的需求也在不断增长，因此显然全球对大米有着强烈的渴望和需求。

sentences.en: So, is it possible to grow rice in a more eco-friendly way?
sentences.zh: 那么，有没有可能以一种更环保的方式种植水稻呢？

sentences.en: Jean-Philippe Laborde, director of rice company, Tilda, thinks the answer lies in a new growing technique called Alternate Wet Drying, or AWD for short.
sentences.zh: 大米公司 Tilda 的总监 Jean-Philippe Laborde 认为，答案在于一种名为“间歇灌溉”（Alternate Wet Drying，简称 AWD）的新种植技术。

sentences.en: To grow rice, farmers go through cycles of flooding their fields, or paddies, which then dry out and need to be flooded again.
sentences.zh: 为了种植水稻，农民需要经历给田地（或稻田）注水然后让其变干再注水的循环。

sentences.en: With AWD, measuring pipes are placed 15cm underground so that farmers can check water levels at any part of the field.
sentences.zh: 使用 AWD 时，测量管被放置在地下 15 厘米处，以便农民检查田地任何部位的水位。

sentences.en: Normally, rice needs 25 cycles of flooding and drying out to grow, but using AWD this is reduced to 20 cycles, saving farmers water and reducing methane emissions.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，水稻生长需要经历 25 次灌溉和晾干的循环，但使用 AWD 可以减少到 20 次，既为农民节约了水资源，又减少了甲烷排放。

sentences.en: Here’s Jean-Philippe Laborde, telling Ruth Alexander, presenter of BBC World Service’s, The Food Chain, how he began his AWD experiment with farmers in India: We've got, last year, 1,268 farmers on board applying this AWD technique to reduce the overall methane emission.
sentences.zh: 下面是 Jean-Philippe Laborde 向 BBC 世界服务部《The Food Chain》节目的主持人 Ruth Alexander 讲述他是如何开始在印度的农民中进行 AWD 实验的：去年，我们有 1,268 名农民加入进来，应用这种 AWD 技术来减少整体甲烷排放。

sentences.en: And how did you persuade those farmers to give it a go?
sentences.zh: 你是如何说服那些农民尝试这种方法的呢？

sentences.en: That was quite challenging because obviously the main challenge is, for farmers, the apprehension to lose revenues.
sentences.zh: 这相当具有挑战性，因为很显然，对农民来说主要的挑战是担心失去收入。

sentences.en: They need to see tangible results at the end of the crop… that they're getting obviously something better.
sentences.zh: 他们需要看到作物收获时产生切实的成果……他们显然能得到更好的东西。

sentences.en: Many Indian farmers got on board with Jean-Phillipe’s experiment.
sentences.zh: 许多印度农民加入了 Jean-Phillipe 的实验。

sentences.en: If you get on board with something, you agree to a plan of action and get involved.
sentences.zh: 如果你参与（get on board with）某事，你就同意了一项行动计划并参与其中。

sentences.en: In other words, you give it a go – you try doing something to see if it works.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你尝试一下（give it a go）——试着做某事看看它是否管用。

sentences.en: As it turned out, the new technique produced tangible results, results which are real and measurable.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这项新技术产生了切实的成果，即真实且可量化的成果。

sentences.en: Using AWD, the amounts of water and electricity needed to grow rice decreased, methane gas emissions reduced, and on top of that, the amount of rice yielded increased…
sentences.zh: 使用 AWD 后，种植水稻所需的水和电力减少了，甲烷气体排放减少了，最重要的是，大米产量增加了……

sentences.en: Right, Neil, isn’t it time you revealed the answer to your question?
sentences.zh: 好了，Neil，是不是该公布你刚才那个问题的答案了？

sentences.en: I asked how many litres of water are needed to grow just 1 kilogram of rice, and the answer was 3,000 to 5,000 litres so thirsty, but not as thirsty as you thought.
sentences.zh: 我问过种植仅仅 1 公斤大米需要多少升水，答案是 3,000 到 5,000 升，所以它很耗水，但没你想的那么夸张。

sentences.en: OK, let’s recap the vocabulary we’ve learned in this programme, starting with commodity, a product, like rice, that can be bought and sold.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们回顾一下本期节目中学习的词汇，首先是 commodity（商品），像大米这样可以买卖的产品。

sentences.en: Varieties of something are different types of it.
sentences.zh: Varieties（品种）指某物的不同类型。

sentences.en: If there’s an appetite for something, there’s a strong desire or demand for it.
sentences.zh: 如果对某事有 appetite（渴望），说明有强烈的欲望或需求。

sentences.en: If you get on board with an idea or a plan, you agree to do something and get involved with doing it.
sentences.zh: 如果你 get on board with（加入/参与）某个想法或计划，即同意做某事并参与其中。

sentences.en: To give it a go means to try doing something.
sentences.zh: To give it a go 的意思是尝试做某事。

sentences.en: And finally, the adjective tangible means real and measurable.
sentences.zh: 最后，形容词 tangible 的意思是真实的、可量化的。

sentences.en: Once again our six minutes are up. If you’ve enjoyed this programme, why not try practising the new vocabulary you’ve learned with our worksheet – it’s available to download now from our website, bbclearningenglish.com… and you could also try out the quiz while you’re there!
sentences.zh: 我们的六分钟时间又到了。如果你喜欢这个节目，为什么不尝试用我们的练习纸来练习你学到的新词汇呢？现在就可以从我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 下载……你还可以在那里顺便做个小测验！

sentences.en: Goodbye for now! Bye!
sentences.zh: 先这样啦，再见！再见！
